title: Generative Actor-Critic with Soft Bridge Policies
abstract: arXiv:2605.08733v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Expressive generative policies such as diffusion and flow models are appealing for maximum-entropy (MaxEnt) online reinforcement learning because of their ability to model multimodal and highly non-Gaussian action distributions. However, training effective soft generative policies faces two obstacles that often arise together. First, marginal action densities are often unavailable, so existing methods typically rely on entropy bounds, heuristic proxies or approximations. Second, iterative shared-parameter samplers raise inference cost and require backpropagation through time over repeated network evaluations, increasing memory cost and potentially destabilizing policy optimization. These obstacles motivate us to seek a generative actor-critic method that exposes a tractable soft objective while generating each action in just one network evaluation. translated_title: 基于软桥接策略的生成式行动者-评论家算法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.08733v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：扩散模型和流模型等表达力强的生成式策略对最大熵在线强化学习非常有吸引力，因为它们能够建模多峰且高度非高斯的动作分布。然而，训练有效的软生成式策略面临两个常常同时出现的障碍。首先，边际动作密度通常不可获得，因此现有方法通常依赖于熵的界、启发式代理或近似方法。其次，迭代式的共享参数采样器提高了推理成本，并且需要对重复的网络评估进行时间上的反向传播，从而增加了内存开销，并可能导致策略优化不稳定。这些障碍促使我们寻求一种生成式行动者-评论家方法，既能提供可处理的软目标，又只需一次网络评估即可生成每个动作。为此，我们提出了软生成式行动者-评论家算法（SoftGAC），其行动者是一个单（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出SoftGAC软生成式行动者-评论家算法，利用软桥接策略在单次网络评估内生成动作并提供可处理的软目标，同时解决了生成式策略训练中边际动作密度不可得和迭代采样推理与内存开销大的两大障碍。
en_tdlr: SoftGAC is a soft generative actor-critic method that employs soft bridge policies to generate each action in a single network evaluation while exposing a tractable soft objective, overcoming the dual obstacles of unavailable marginal action densities and the high inference and memory costs of iterative sampling in generative reinforcement learning.
